records.source_title: 12-27-2025 13:24:47 Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 - OLED Care - Low power byKermoneninY Gaming Accessories & Curved Gaming Monitors Hi, I need some clarification regarding the Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 OLED Care menu. Also a request for Lenovo: could you please update the manual with proper explanations
records.author: Hassen_Lenovo
records.text:
Hi Kermonen,
Thank you for your inquiry regarding the Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 OLED Care menu. I appreciate your feedback about the manual and your request for more detailed explanations.
The
Low Power
option in the OLED Care menu is designed to optimize energy consumption and reduce power usage during operation. When enabled, it may adjust certain display settings to achieve lower power consumption, which can contribute to prolonged panel lifespan and reduced energy costs. However, this might slightly impact peak brightness or performance in certain scenarios.
If the feature is enabled by default, it is generally recommended to leave it on unless specific usage requirements necessitate its deactivation.
For further assistance or detailed specifications, you can visit the
Lenovo Product Specifications Reference (PSREF)
or contact
Lenovo Support
.
Best regards, Hassen_Lenovo
